metaDescription: Volunteer with Brick City Glam, Storytelling Knights, or the Marion County Maker Collective.

sections.introLede: Show your support for the arts with your time. Below are ways to plug in across our programs.

sections.sitHeading: Apply To Join Our Board of Directors
sections.sitBody:
We're looking for board members like you!

Share your skills.  Guide our mission.  Make an impact..  Apply now!
sections.sitImageAlt: Brick City Glam volunteers and performance

sections.sitBody: Onstage or behind the scenes — audio and lighting technicians, merch, marketing (digital and street team), stage management, and production assistant roles.
sections.sitImageAlt: Brick City Glam volunteers and performance

sections.sitBody: Marketing, event assistants (setup, strike, check-in), program development (help shape the next adventure), and a training path for official storytellers.
Lead maker meetups, instruct classes and workshops, assist with team builds, marketing (digital and in-person events), and check-in / gift shop.
sections.sitImageAlt: Makers and tools at the collective

sections.sitBody: Volunteers keep performances on stage, tables set for storytelling, and the makerspace welcoming. Every hour you give helps neighbors access creative programs across Marion County.
